_doc: Creates a component set with Cartesian product of variant axes. Clones a base node for each variant combination, renames them, and combines into a COMPONENT_SET.
_usage: Replace placeholders. Send commands sequentially — each step depends on previous IDs.
_pattern: 1. Clone base node for each variant combination
2. Convert each clone to a component (createComponent with nodeId)
4. Combine all variants into a COMPONENT_SET

1_clone_base._doc: Clone the source frame once per variant

4_combine_as_variant_set._doc: Combine all variant components into a set

5_add_boolean_property._doc: Add a boolean toggle (e.g., Show Icon)

6_add_instance_swap._doc: Add instance swap (defaultValue is a node ID, NOT component key)

7_link_child_to_property._doc: Connect a child node's visibility/swap to the property
